settings.title:
Three Decades
in the Making
settings.body_text:
Laura Milman's story began in the heart of New York's Diamond District, where she spent thirty years learning what makes a jewel worth keeping. Today every Laura Milman New York piece is designed in the city that trained her eye — and brought to life by master goldsmiths in Italy.

Newly made or newly rediscovered, each piece is chosen the same way: it must be beautiful enough to buy once, and made well enough to hand down.
